title: Faster everyday workflows
summary: AD Tools 1.3.6 makes saved work easier to reach, refreshes two core tools, and uses fewer resources in the background.
notes: Quick Query has a roomier data sheet, clearer wrap controls, safer database pasting, and improved tab handling.
Pin favorite tools in the sidebar so they stay at the top.
Press ⌘K to search tools, pages, and saved Quick Query tables.
Home now shows your usage and includes a feedback field.
Check Image adds a clearer batch workflow, saved references, result filters, cancellation, and timeout retries.
Heavy tools and background work now release resources more efficiently to reduce RAM and compute usage.

slides.title: Quick Query, with more working room
slides.body: Work with large schemas and data sets more comfortably, with a data sheet that sizes predictably and can expand when you need the space.
bullets: Paste copied database rows with better handling for malformed TSV data.
Use clearer wrap controls for long SQL and cell values.
Keep multiple tasks organized with improved Quick Query tabs.

slides.title: Your shortcuts, wherever you are
slides.body: Keep frequent tools pinned in the sidebar, or press ⌘K to jump directly to a tool, page, or saved Quick Query table.
bullets: Right-click a sidebar tool to pin or unpin it.
Search remembers recent destinations and brings them forward.

slides.title: A more useful Home and Check Image
slides.body: Home now combines usage context with a direct feedback field, while Check Image makes repeated batch checks easier to manage.
bullets: Save friendly labels for image identifiers you use often.
Filter results, cancel a run, and retry timed-out checks.
Configure CDN environment URLs from Settings.

tips.title: Pin a favorite tool
tips.body: Right-click any tool in the sidebar and choose Pin. Pinned tools stay together at the top; repeat the action to unpin one.

tips.title: Search with ⌘K
tips.body: Press ⌘K from anywhere. Type qq: followed by a table name to open a saved Quick Query table directly.

tips.title: Send feedback from Home
tips.body: Choose a tool if relevant, describe what should be better, and send your note without leaving Home.

tips.title: Shape the Quick Query data sheet
tips.body: Use Wrap Text for long values and Expand Data Sheet when you need more room. You can also paste copied database rows directly into the grid.

tips.title: Reuse image references
tips.body: Open Saved references to keep friendly labels beside identifiers you check often. Batch runs also support filtering, cancellation, and timeout retries.
